authorization_scope: PASS would authorize qualifier implementation engineering only, not ALFWorld qualification science or residual capture. MATERIAL_REPAIR_REQUIRED blocks implementation until a prospective no-outcome repair and fresh independent review.

material_defects.finding: Frozen sanity qualifies plan *content* <=96 model tokens, but addendum requires the complete tagged <PLAN>...</PLAN> string / entire plan_text <=96 tokens. Tags therefore consume the scientific qualification budget and can change the qualified family set.
material_defects.required_repair: Bind the <=96 gate to the content inside the single <PLAN>...</PLAN> block exactly as registered. Define the exact tokenizer call on interior content; keep generation max_new_tokens=128 separately. Do not change population/min16 or inspect outcomes.

material_defects.finding: The executor freezes system/user text and suffix scoring, but does not freeze the exact tokenizer.apply_chat_template invocation, add_generation_prompt setting, or enable_thinking argument at executor scoring time. These choices change prefix tokens and candidate likelihoods.
material_defects.required_repair: Freeze the exact executor chat-template call and token boundary, including roles, tokenize flag, add_generation_prompt, enable_thinking=False, and exact location of ACTION: relative to any assistant-generation marker. Preserve the current mean-FP32 suffix score and lexical tie-break.

material_defects.finding: Generation/EOS/fullmatch are frozen, but converting generated token IDs to text is not: skip_special_tokens and cleanup behavior are unspecified. This can change whether an otherwise identical generation passes exact fullmatch/reasoning guards.
material_defects.required_repair: Freeze tokenizer.decode arguments for newly generated IDs, including skip_special_tokens and clean_up_tokenization_spaces (and any other non-default behavior relied upon), before fullmatch. No semantic retries.

material_defects.finding: Registered sanity qualification requires all seven replay controls, including NEXT_ACTION_PRESERVED_LATE_NULL, to construct exactly; failure is qualification failure. Addendum qualified_iff omits this criterion yet writes a final qualified boolean. This changes qualification semantics.
material_defects.required_repair: Restore exact all-seven control constructibility to the final qualified gate (or make trajectory packet status explicitly provisional and prohibit final qualified=true until deterministic control construction validation passes). Freeze unrelated-plan donor and late-null constructibility rules before outcomes.

material_defects.finding: The addendum atomically writes one packet per index as it proceeds. Although stdout is coarse, per-family scientific outcomes become inspectable on disk before all32 complete, conflicting with the no-partial-outcome review requirement.
material_defects.required_repair: Write packets into a fresh private staging directory and publish the all32 packet set plus summary only after all32 attempts complete and validation passes (e.g. fsync then atomic directory/final-manifest publication). No resume or partial peeking.
